subject: Acquisition
detail: Insecticides (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about the execution of a Share Subscription and Shareholders Agreement with FP Alpha Private Limited and the subsequent allotment of 7,86,745 equity shares pursuant to the said agreement.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
detail: Insecticides (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Analyst / Institutional Investor meetings under the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations 2015.
